question: Of the Aspen Plus models of biodiesel production by triolein transesterification, which gave the lowest conversion, whose kinetic parameters did it use, and what catalyst did it use?
expect: Model 5 (21%); Singh and Ali; K+ impregnated H3PW12O40.xH2O on graphene oxide (potassium-imbued phosphotungstic acid) (Table 1; sec. 2.3.5; Table 10)
rendered:
The document title is "Development of an Aspen Plus model for catalytic transesterification with different reactor arrangements and kinetic mechanisms".

The lowest conversion was given by Model 5, with a conversion of 21%.

Model 5 used power law kinetics.

Model 5 used potassium imbued phosphotungstic acid as the heterogeneous catalyst.
